android.desc:
Not a quit app. A mirror.

SmokeWatcher shows you your real smoking patterns  without shame, streaks that reset to zero, or a quit deadline you'll break by Friday. Just honest data on when, why, and how often you smoke.

Most quit apps treat willpower as the problem. SmokeWatcher treats it as awareness. When you can see your own patterns clearly the 3 PM stress dip, the after-coffee ritual, the friend who always makes you crave one  change becomes easier because you finally understand what's driving the habit.

FEATURES

Live smoking dial
See exactly how long since your last cigarette. The needle swings red when you're smoking too often visible every time you unlock your phone via the home screen widget.

10-minute urge timer
When the urge hits, tap "beat the urge" and a 10-minute countdown starts. Urges biologically fade in under 10 minutes  the timer helps you wait it out. Choose from alternatives (chocolate, cold water, breathing) to distract yourself. Log wins and slips honestly.

Real insights
After a few weeks, see your peak craving times, most effective alternatives, and streak trends. Weekly bar charts show progress without shaming setbacks.

Honest badges
Earn badges for clean streaks (Spark, Flint, Coal, all the way up to Diamond at 30 days). Every badge requires you to confirm you actually earned it — no fake progress, no auto-inflated numbers.

Friends and leaderboard
Connect with friends using 6-character codes. Compare streaks, see each other's progress, keep each other accountable. No search, no discovery — you pick who's in your circle.

Home screen widget
Your smoking dial, elapsed time, and streak sit on your phone's home screen  passive pressure that doesn't require nagging notifications.

Cost tracker
See how much money smoking is costing you daily and monthly. Real numbers, real motivation.

OUR PHILOSOPHY

We won't lecture you.
We won't reset your streak with shame.
We won't send push notifications telling you to stop.
We won't share your data with anyone.
We won't sell you subscriptions or paywalls.

We'll give you a mirror. What you do with what you see is up to you.

PRIVACY FIRST

- Your smoking data stays in your account
- Sign in with Google or email  that's it
- No location tracking
- No selling data to advertisers
- Delete your account and all data anytime from Settings

Full privacy policy: smokewatcher.projectw.in/privacy

FREE FOREVER

No subscriptions. No paywalls. Just a
